detail.longDescription:
OK HTML nerds - I have a question which I can't answer. Guesses and speculation very welcome!

HTML uses BCP 47 for language tags. For example `lang="en-GB`.

OGP uses `content="en_GB"` for the locale.

Why does Open Graph Protocol use underscores rather than hyphens?

Also, why doesn't it use the `lang` attribute?

#HTML #WebDev #OpenGraphProtocol
